# Shopping List Builder

Shopping List Builder is where staff design printable shopping list templates.

## Who Should Use It?

Use the Builder if you are responsible for how the printed list looks or what information appears on it.

If you only need to print an existing list, use [Shopping Lists](07-shopping-lists.md).

## What You Build

You build a reusable template, not a one-time list.

![Shopping List Builder with component panel, page canvas, and page settings](/help-screenshots/shopping-list-builder-canvas.png)

The template can include:

- Text.
- Dates.
- Form fields.
- Inventory sections.
- Saved components.
- Headers and footers.

## Guided Mode And Freeform Mode

Guided mode helps keep items aligned and prevents common layout problems.

Freeform mode gives more placement freedom. Use it when Guided mode gets in the way of a specific layout need.

## How To Add Inventory To A Template

1. Open Shopping List Builder.
2. Choose an inventory section from the side panel.
3. Add it to the page.
4. Review how the rows fit.
5. Save the template when the layout is ready.

## Why Inventory Sections Stay Connected

Inventory sections use live pantry data.

That means item names, limits, and stock status come from Inventory. This keeps printed lists accurate when the pantry changes.

## Translation Settings

Use Translation Settings when a printed list needs translated text, English text, or both.

For many rows, showing the translated item with the English name can help staff and clients confirm they are talking about the same food.

## What To Check Before Printing

- The right template is loaded.
- Inventory sections fit on the page.
- Limits look correct.
- Translation settings match the client need.
- The PDF preview looks like the intended printout.
